instruction.name: vfmax.s
instruction.description: Compute the maximum (maxNum) of single precision floating point elements in `a` and `b`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Vector registers initialised with normal 1.0/2.0 values, not byte-replicated integers. Measured with unroll=100000.
